description: Businesses and places from Google Maps, 20 per page: name, type, rating and review count, price, address, phone, hours, website, coordinates and place_id. Put the place in the query ("plumber in denver co") or pass ll. Each page is one billed search. Without an API key, pay per call in USDC on Base with x402 (the first call answers with the price).

country.description: Two-letter country code Google searches from (gl), e.g. "us", "gb", "de". Default "us".

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "pizza in austin tx".

name: google_maps_search
title: Google Maps search
